Add a {IfUpgraded:show:Qi+|Qi} to your Hand.

HEAVYSILENT_QI_BLADE.description:
Can only be played if you have Qi in your Hand.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a Qi in your Hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
HEAVYSILENT_LINGERING_BREATH.title: Lingering Breath
HEAVYSILENT_LINGERING_BREATH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {Cards:diff()} Qi to your Discard Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_PRESSURE.title: Pressure
HEAVYSILENT_PRESSURE.description:
Deal damage equal to the larger of your Draw and Discard Pile sizes{IfUpgraded:show:, plus 5|}.
({CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)
HEAVYSILENT_SAP.title: Sap
HEAVYSILENT_SAP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [gold]Weak[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
HEAVYSILENT_SWEEP.title: Sweep
HEAVYSILENT_THREEFOLD.title: Threefold
HEAVYSILENT_THREEFOLD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
HEAVYSILENT_HEAVY_EDGE.title: Heavy Edge
HEAVYSILENT_HEAVY_EDGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less for every {Interval} cards in your Discard Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_RETURNING_EDGE.title: Returning Edge
HEAVYSILENT_RETURNING_EDGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put a card from your Discard Pile into your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_RETURNING_EDGE.selectionScre: Choose a card to put into your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_HIDDEN_BLADE.title: Hidden Blade
HEAVYSILENT_HIDDEN_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Recruit[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
When this card is [gold]Milled[/gold], play it.
HEAVYSILENT_ETCH.title: Etch
HEAVYSILENT_ETCH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: Choose a card in your Deck to permanently gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_ETCH.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to permanently gain Retain.
HEAVYSILENT_TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
HEAVYSILENT_TRANSMUTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Transform a card in your Discard Pile into {IfUpgraded:show:Qi+|Qi}.
HEAVYSILENT_TRANSMUTE.selectionScreenPro: Choose a card to transform into Qi.
HEAVYSILENT_EMBERS.title: Embers
HEAVYSILENT_EMBERS.description:
Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage, plus {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each Qi in your Exhaust Pile.
({CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)
HEAVYSILENT_FLURRY.title: Flurry
HEAVYSILENT_FLURRY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Repeat once for each time you have [gold]Milled[/gold] this turn.
HEAVYSILENT_OPENING_NOTE.title: Opening Note
HEAVYSILENT_OPENING_NOTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a {IfUpgraded:show:Qi+|Qi} to your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_POISE.title: Poise
HEAVYSILENT_POISE.description:
Deal damage equal to your Discard Pile size.
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your Draw Pile size.
({CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage; {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].)
HEAVYSILENT_EBB.title: Ebb
HEAVYSILENT_EBB.description:
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}.
Deal damage equal to the number of cards that entered your Discard Pile this turn{IfUpgraded:show:, plus 3|}.
({CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)
HEAVYSILENT_SPLIT_BREATH.title: Split Breath
HEAVYSILENT_SPLIT_BREATH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add Qi equal to half the damage dealt (rounded down) to EACH of your Draw and Discard Piles.
HEAVYSILENT_RESURGENCE.title: Resurgence
HEAVYSILENT_RESURGENCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your Draw Pile has been shuffled this turn, deal damage 2 additional times.
HEAVYSILENT_SEVERANCE.title: Severance
HEAVYSILENT_SEVERANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
When you choose this card as a card reward, remove a card from your Deck.
HEAVYSILENT_SEVERANCE.selectionScreenPro: Choose a card to remove from your Deck.
HEAVYSILENT_NULLITY.title: Nullity
HEAVYSILENT_NULLITY.description:
[gold]Mill[/gold] X.
If your Draw Pile is empty, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
HEAVYSILENT_BLADE_CYCLE.title: Blade Cycle
HEAVYSILENT_BLADE_CYCLE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}.
Play this card again.
HEAVYSILENT_FLEETING_EDGE.title: Fleeting Edge
HEAVYSILENT_FLEETING_EDGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Whenever you [gold]Mill[/gold], move this card from your Draw Pile into your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_ONE_INCH.title: One Inch
HEAVYSILENT_ONE_INCH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less for each Qi played this turn.
HEAVYSILENT_PURGE.title: Purge
HEAVYSILENT_PURGE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status cards in your combat piles, except the Exhaust Pile.
For each card Exhausted, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to the same enemy.
HEAVYSILENT_AFTERGLOW.title: Afterglow
HEAVYSILENT_AFTERGLOW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}.
Heal the enemy for {Heal} HP.
HEAVYSILENT_STONEWALL.title: Stonewall
HEAVYSILENT_LAYERED_GUARD.title: Layered Guard
HEAVYSILENT_HIDDEN_BREATH.title: Hidden Breath
HEAVYSILENT_HIDDEN_BREATH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Add a {IfUpgraded:show:Qi+|Qi} to your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_READINESS.title: Readiness
HEAVYSILENT_OLD_RAMPART.title: Old Rampart
HEAVYSILENT_OLD_RAMPART.description:
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number of cards in your Discard Pile.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
HEAVYSILENT_OPENING.title: Opening
HEAVYSILENT_SPLIT_SHADOW.title: Split Shadow
HEAVYSILENT_SPLIT_SHADOW.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. When drawn, add {Cards:diff()} copies of this card to your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_BIDE.title: Bide
HEAVYSILENT_BIDE.description: [gold]Retain[/gold] your Hand this turn. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
HEAVYSILENT_BREATHWORK.title: Breathwork
HEAVYSILENT_BREATHWORK.description: [gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Play all Qi milled this way.
HEAVYSILENT_LIGHTFOOT.title: Lightfoot
HEAVYSILENT_IMPRINT.title: Imprint
HEAVYSILENT_IMPRINT.description: Choose an Attack or Skill in your Hand. Add {Cards:diff()} copies of it to your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_IMPRINT.selectionScreenPromp: Choose an Attack or Skill to copy.
HEAVYSILENT_HONED_ARMOR.title: Honed Armor
HEAVYSILENT_HONED_ARMOR.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each time you have [gold]Milled[/gold] this turn.
HEAVYSILENT_EVEN_BREATH.title: Even Breath
HEAVYSILENT_EVEN_BREATH.description: Add Qi to your Draw or Discard Pile until both contain the same number of Qi. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number added.
HEAVYSILENT_WINDFALL.title: Windfall
HEAVYSILENT_WINDFALL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. When chosen from a card reward, also obtain the other cards in that reward.
HEAVYSILENT_CHOSEN_EDGE.title: Chosen Edge
HEAVYSILENT_CHOSEN_EDGE.description: [gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Choose one of those cards to play.
HEAVYSILENT_CHOSEN_EDGE.selectionScreenP: Choose a milled card to play.
HEAVYSILENT_NURTURE_QI.title: Nurture Qi
HEAVYSILENT_NURTURE_QI.description: Add {Cards:diff()} Qi to your Hand. They gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_RECLAIM.title: Reclaim
HEAVYSILENT_RECLAIM.description: [gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}. Put those cards from your Discard Pile into your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_BURN_BREATH.title: Burn Breath
HEAVYSILENT_BURN_BREATH.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] any number of Qi in your Hand. Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to their total draw amount.
HEAVYSILENT_UNDERCURRENT.title: Undercurrent
HEAVYSILENT_UNDERCURRENT.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. When this card is [gold]Milled[/gold], play it.
HEAVYSILENT_FORESIGHT.title: Foresight
HEAVYSILENT_FORESIGHT.description: Choose X{IfUpgraded:show:+1|} cards in your Hand to [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn. Next turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to their total current cost when chosen.
HEAVYSILENT_FORESIGHT.selectionScreenPro: Choose {Amount} cards to Retain this turn.
HEAVYSILENT_RESERVE.title: Reserve
HEAVYSILENT_RESERVE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Give a card in your Hand [gold]Retain[/gold] this combat.
HEAVYSILENT_RESERVE.selectionScreenPromp: Choose a card to gain Retain.
HEAVYSILENT_DOUBLE_VISION.title: Double Vision
HEAVYSILENT_STILL_WATER.title: Still Water
HEAVYSILENT_STILL_WATER.description: Can only be played if your Draw and Discard Piles have the same number of cards. [gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies.
HEAVYSILENT_EMPTY_MOUNTAIN.title: Empty Mountain
HEAVYSILENT_EMPTY_MOUNTAIN.description: [gold]Mill[/gold] your entire Draw Pile. Add a Qi to your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_ALL_IN.title: All In
HEAVYSILENT_ALL_IN.description: Cards in your Hand cost 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} this turn. You may [gold]Mill[/gold] 4 for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} you cannot pay to play this card.
HEAVYSILENT_RETURN_TO_QI.title: Return to Qi
HEAVYSILENT_RETURN_TO_QI.description: Transform your Hand into Qi. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card transformed.
HEAVYSILENT_RECURRENCE.title: Recurrence
HEAVYSILENT_RECURRENCE.description: [gold]Recruit[/gold] {Cards:diff()}. At the end of your turn, if this card is in your Discard Pile, put it on top of your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_PARTING_MARK.title: Parting Mark
HEAVYSILENT_PARTING_MARK.description: Cannot be upgraded. When this card appears in a card reward, the other cards permanently gain [gold]Innate[/gold] and [gold]Retain[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_FLYING_SAND.title: Flying Sand
HEAVYSILENT_FLYING_SAND.description: Whenever you [gold]Mill[/gold], deal {FlyingSandPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
HEAVYSILENT_RESTORE_ORDER.title: Restore Order
HEAVYSILENT_RESTORE_ORDER.description: At the end of your turn, you may put 1 card from your Discard Pile on top of your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_YIN_AND_YANG.title: Yin and Yang
HEAVYSILENT_YIN_AND_YANG.description: At the start of odd-numbered turns, gain {YinAndYangPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]. On even-numbered turns, gain {YinAndYangPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold] instead.
HEAVYSILENT_QI_MANTLE.title: Qi Mantle
HEAVYSILENT_NIGHT_BREATH.title: Night Breath
HEAVYSILENT_NIGHT_BREATH.description: At the end of your turn, shuffle 1 [gold]Qi+[/gold] into your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_SIMPLE_GUARD.title: Simple Guard
HEAVYSILENT_SIMPLE_GUARD.description: At the end of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number of cards in your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_LASTING_BREATH.title: Lasting Breath
HEAVYSILENT_RECALL.title: Recall
HEAVYSILENT_RECALL.description: At the start of your turn, draw 2 fewer cards and put 3 random cards from your Discard Pile into your Hand.
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING.title: Fine Tuning
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING.description: Choose one: increase or decrease all your [gold]Mill[/gold] amounts by 1 this combat.
HEAVYSILENT_FLOWING_GUARD.title: Flowing Guard
HEAVYSILENT_FLOWING_GUARD.description: Whenever you [gold]Mill[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the Mill amount.
HEAVYSILENT_ANTICIPATION.title: Anticipation
HEAVYSILENT_REFLECTION.title: Reflection
HEAVYSILENT_REFLECTION.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Retain your Hand this turn. |}Whenever you retain a card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it this combat.
HEAVYSILENT_FRESH_FORGE.title: Fresh Forge
HEAVYSILENT_FRESH_FORGE.description: Cards you generate in combat are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING_INCREASE.title: Deepen
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING_INCREASE.descrip: Add +1 to all your [gold]Mill[/gold] amounts this combat.
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING_DECREASE.title: Ease
HEAVYSILENT_FINE_TUNING_DECREASE.descrip: Add -1 to all your [gold]Mill[/gold] amounts this combat.
HEAVYSILENT_GATHER_BREATH.title: Gather Breath
HEAVYSILENT_GATHER_BREATH.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Shuffle a Qi into your Draw Pile.
HEAVYSILENT_OBLIQUE_STRIKE.title: Oblique Strike
HEAVYSILENT_OBLIQUE_STRIKE.description:
[gold]Mill[/gold] {Mill:diff()}.
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage, equal to the absolute difference between your Draw and Discard Pile sizes.
HEAVYSILENT_CONFLUENCE.title: Confluence
HEAVYSILENT_CONFLUENCE.description:
[gold]Perfect Fit[/gold].
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage, equal to the combined size of your Draw and Discard Piles.
HEAVYSILENT_SHIFTING_MERIDIANS.title: Shifting Meridians
HEAVYSILENT_SHIFTING_MERIDIANS.descripti:
When short on Energy, [gold]Mill[/gold] 2 cards per missing Energy to pay.
Qi now [gold]Recruits[/gold] instead of drawing.
